thesis: The conversation argues that the primary error in AI investing is zero-sum thinking, as value creation has occurred at every layer of the stack regardless of market concentration. While a monopoly scenario could allow a dominant provider to capture margins or market share from application developers, historical precedents like the cloud market suggest that independent consumption layers will likely emerge and thrive even if a single provider dominates the model layer.
